meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在接手计算繁重的任务前会先运行检测脚本,探测本机 CPU、GPU、内存等状态,生成脱敏的 .claude_resources.json 报告,并给出并行度、GPU 加速、内存策略等建议;它不做压力测试,也不假设本机硬件都能用。
howto.when: 当用户要求根据资源情况做规划,或即将开始明显消耗资源的本地任务(如大数据分析、模型训练、大规模并行处理)时触发。

say.text: 先检测本机 CPU 和内存,再决定怎么处理这个 50GB 数据集。
say.note: Claude 会先产出资源报告,再选择读取方式。

say.text: 训练模型前先看看有没有可用的 GPU,并推荐后端。
say.note: Claude 会检查 GPU 类型并给出对应方案。

say.text: 批量处理 1 万份文件前,先探测资源并给出并行方案。
say.note: Claude 会根据核心数建议 worker 数量。

howto.what_en: After installation, before starting heavy computing tasks, Claude runs a detection script, writes a redacted .claude_resources.json report, and suggests parallelism, GPU acceleration, and memory strategies. It performs no stress tests and does not assume host hardware is usable.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for resource-aware planning, or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload such as analyzing a large dataset, training a model, or large-scale parallel processing.

say_en.text: Check local CPU and memory first, then decide how to process this 50GB dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a resource report, then pick a loading strategy.

say_en.text: Before training the model, check for available GPUs and recommend a backend.
say_en.note: Claude will detect GPU type and suggest a matching stack.

say_en.text: Before batch-processing 10,000 files, probe resources and propose a parallel plan.
say_en.note: Claude will detect core count and recommend a worker count.
